summary: GC (COMEX gold) dossier delivered per DOSSIER_TEMPLATE.md, all 7 sections, every claim tagged FACT/OBSERVED/POSTULATED/NOT_RUN. Descriptive statistics computed from the legal raw snapshot (22 GC contracts x 5 job types) with a disclosed script using strict past/rolling windows; no PnL/event-studies/sweeps/performance metrics. Primary official sources fetched for the event calendar (federalreserve.gov FOMC 2026 dates, bls.gov CPI+NFP 2026 schedules, bea.gov PCE partial, cftc.gov CoT release rule); CME official numeric spec table not retrievable (JS-driven page via web-reader fallback; direct WebFetch times out) - specs rest on broker secdef S1 (OBSERVED) + vendor mirrors (secondary, flagged).
findings: Roll-rule executability defect: the raw set contains NO serial months for 2025-11..2026-09 (GCX5, GCF6, GCH6, GCK6, GCN6, GCU6 never fetched), so the data lane's declared roll rule (roll to next listed at last session before delivery month) is NOT executable on this dataset for 2025-09..2026-09; dossier chain uses a disclosed cycle-skip approximation. Cheapest fix: re-fetch the 6 serial contracts under the existing entitlement (expired-secdef resolves that window).

Liquidity migration OBSERVED: on the five thick-volume real-era cycle rolls, the next contract's daily volume crosses above the old contract's 1-2 sessions BEFORE the declared roll session (e.g. GCJ6 8,201 vs GCM6 82,091 on 2026-03-27, roll 2026-03-31); declared calendar rule is 1-2 sessions later than the market's migration.

Vendor volume-scale artifact: G/J/M/Q/Z-month contracts record full-scale volume (~30k-260k lots/day when front) but GCV5 (front Aug-Sep 2025 median ~3.0k) and GCV6 (front Aug-Sep 2026 median ~3.2k) are 1-2 orders thin; hourly sums match dailies where checked (GCV6 2026-08-20: 6068=6068), so it is per-contract vendor recording. Volume usable for relative migration timing only, never absolute liquidity.

Term structure: persistent contango - near-below-far on 99.8-100% of overlapping sessions for all 13 measured pairs (median 2-month spread ~19-24 USD/oz, 12-month ~39-42; 2026-10-01 deferred curve +15.2..+19.5 USD/oz per month, ~4.5%/yr carry); backwardation essentially absent in this data.

Vol regime shift OBSERVED: annualized daily vol 14-15% (2023-24) -> ~20.5% (2025) -> ~30.7% (2026 Jan-Sep); worst day -12.07% on 2026-01-30 after the 2026-01 spike to ~5,718-5,730 USD/oz (crash day range GCZ6 5,729->5,280); rolling 21-session vol peaked 56.7% annualized.

Daily behavior descriptives (real-volume era 2025-01-15..2026-10-01, n=424 within-contract log returns): mean +0.085%/day, sigma 1.61%, positive days 54.5%, lag-1 autocorr -0.11 (mild daily mean-reversion), |r| lag-1 +0.11 (mild clustering), trend-sign persistence ~51% (coin-flip).

RTH-only intraday profile (4,001 hourly bars, 09:30-16:00 ET labels): volume share peaks in the 10:00 ET hour (24.0%) and decays to 3.9% by 16:00; median range 0.40%->0.09%. Asia/London/COMEX-open (18:00 ET) session behavior NOT_RUN - useRTH=True files contain no overnight bars.

Costs OBSERVED/reconciled: front GCV6 last-20-session median BID/ASK close spread 5 ticks = $50/contract (reconciles S6_FRONT_SPREADS GC 5.0 ticks/$50); deferred GCX6 1Y median 42 ticks collapsing to 5 once front; crossed days 0 except GCX7 (1); IBKR commission $0.85/side + exchange fee NOT_FETCHED; slippage NOT_RUN_NO_DECLARED_VALUE; margin ~$22.4-24.6k (public broker pages, CME SPAN blocked).

Event calendar FACT (accessed 2026-10-02): FOMC 2026 remaining Oct 27-28, Dec 8-9; CPI Oct 14/Nov 10/Dec 10 08:30 ET; NFP Oct 2/Nov 6/Dec 4 08:30 ET; PCE Oct 29/Nov 25/Dec 23 08:30 ET (earlier 2026 PCE dates NOT_FETCHED); CoT weekly Fri 15:30 ET with Tuesday as-of positions, not revised.

GC real-volume continuous depth is 2025-01-15..2026-10-01 on the executable chain (longer than the generic ~2025-08 claim) but tracks a deferred curve point part of the time due to the missing serials; single-contract Dec series (GCZ5/GCZ6 full life) provide clean settlement-derived long-horizon references 2019-12..2026-10.
